events.text:
I fixed `tax()` in `src/invoice.py`, but I couldn't run the tests, so CI has to confirm it.

The function was rounding down with `math.floor`. For `112.50 × 0.09 = 10.125`, that gave 10.12. Finance policy FIN-12, which the test cites, requires half-up rounding to the cent, so the expected 10.13 is correct and the code was wrong. I left the test unchanged.

The new version uses `Decimal` with `ROUND_HALF_UP`. It builds the `Decimal` values from `str(amount)` and `str(rate)`, so float representation error can't skew a half-cent case.

Any other caller that relied on the old round-down behaviour will now see results up to a cent higher. The repo only contains `tax()` and this one test, so I couldn't check for other callers.
